Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE Legal Opinion s. 2011 JUL MR. LUIS ONG luisong(@yahoo.com Dear Mr. Ong, This pertains to your e-mail communication requesting this Department to take action on the alleged practice by several local government units (LGUs) such as Pasay, Muntinlupa, Batangas, Laguna, Bulacan, and Pampanga, of requiring delivery trucks to secure stickers before allowing the same to "access their area." In response thereto, please be advised that due to the failure of your query to point out certain relevant information, such as the particular legal basis of the LGUs concerned in imposing such requirement, this Department is precluded from rendering any opinion on the matter. Be that as it may, please be guided that under the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC), each LGU has the power to create its own sources of revenue and to levy taxes, fees, and charges subject to the provisions of the said law, consistent with the basic policy of local autonomy. Taking this into consideration, the regulation in question which requires delivery trucks to secure stickers may or may not fall within the taxing powers of the LGUs, depending on the nature of imposition involved and the particular LGU concerned. However, this Department, acting on reports that some LGUs are imposing various fees, taxes and other charges which are beyond the scope of their taxing powers, had already issued Memorandum Circular No. 2006-70 dated 26 June 2006, with the subject: "SUSPENSION OF LGU IMPOSITION AND COLLECTION OF ILLEGAL FEES AND TAXES." The said circular enjoined all local chief executives to: l) refrain from enforcing any existing ordinance authorizing the levy of fees and taxes on inter-province transport of goods, regulatory fees from passengers in local ports, and other additional taxes, or charges in any form upon transporting goods and passengers; and 2) cause the immediate repeal of the ordinance imposing the said fees and charges. Consequently, based on the foregoing, the more appropriate remedy on your part is to report to this Department the particular LGUs alleged to be engaged in the practice of imposing and collecting illegal fees and taxes, attaching therewith copies of receipts and stickers which were issued in connection thereto, in order to determine whether or not the same is being made in violation of Memorandum Circular No. 2006-70. We hope to have informed you accordingly. Very truly yours, ATfY. JES k B. QUE Director 111 I egal:03
